canvas.note: draw at 270x270 with nearest filtering, export at 4x; all coordinates below are base px

font.big_values: title-card lettering (font_kaito5x7 caps/digits at 2x or 3x, 2 px ink outline, gold ramp, coloured extrude)
font.gag: font_kaito5x7 at 2x with ink outline, #ffbcea, #eb31bc shadow (drops to 1x if wider than 262 px)

hero.content: dynamic: sprite of highest rank reached, integer scale fitting 112x112, 2 px ink ring, burst in form colours

right_column.content: REBORN AS / form name (dynamic, on ink plate; 3x, else 2x, else 2 lines at 2x) / REACHED + 3 rank tiles (lit = rank reached) / rank name (dynamic; 2x, else 2 lines at 2x)

stat_score.format: thousands comma, e.g. 4,210; 3x if <=104 px wide else 2x

stat_died_to.content: dynamic: killer sprite (1x, max 44 px tall, cropped if taller) + short label at y 226

gag.content: dynamic: gag line, max 262 px wide
